categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the power electronics sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of power electronic conversion and control equipment. Its main product lines include precision test power supplies, special power supplies, and power quality control devices. These products serve various industries such as new energy, aerospace, rail transit, scientific research, power distribution, and special equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies including high-density power conversion, high-precision intelligent control, and product support platforms. It employs digital control systems based on FPGA, high-efficiency DC converter topologies, modular and reconfigurable power electronic circuit architectures, and multi-scenario simulation for test power supplies. Production methods include MTS (make to stock), ATO (assemble to order), and MTO (make to order), with a focus on modular design, high-frequency switching, and digital intelligent control to enhance product performance and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in photovoltaic energy storage, new energy vehicles, aerospace, rail transit, scientific research institutions, and large state-owned enterprises such as China National Grid and China Railway groups. The company also serves certification bodies and research institutes. Its products are widely used in sectors requiring high precision and reliability in power supply and quality control.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with offices and subsidiaries in multiple cities including Xi'an, Suzhou, Beijing, and Hong Kong. It has begun expanding into international markets, focusing on Southeast Asia and Europe through authorized overseas agents and supporting domestic clients' overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the power electronics supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of power conversion and control equipment. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and technical services to downstream customers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous investment in R&D to maintain technological leadership, focusing on high-precision digital control, high-density power conversion, and modular product platforms. The company emphasizes collaboration with universities and research institutes for innovation, development of new products for emerging applications such as new energy and aerospace, and expansion of intelligent and green power electronics technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of power electronic products including precision test power supplies, special power supplies, and power quality control devices. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, with customized solutions for specific industry needs. Additional revenue comes from technical services and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international and domestic power electronics manufacturers, including AMETEK, EA, and Chroma in the test power supply segment. It holds a leading position domestically, especially in new energy and aerospace sectors, with products achieving performance parity or superiority over international brands. The company is recognized for its innovation and has a strong brand presence in China’s power electronics industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 972 million, representing a 17.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 73.1 million, a decline due to increased R&D investment and market competition. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 2.37 billion and equity of RMB 1.86 billion, with a workforce of over 1,000 employees including 429 R&D personnel. It maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by continuous innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, high power density, and intelligent control in its products, offering advanced digital control systems and modular architectures that enable flexible, scalable solutions. Its products provide superior dynamic response, reliability, and energy efficiency, tailored to demanding applications in new energy, aerospace, and scientific research. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio underpin its competitive differentiation and ability to meet evolving customer needs.
